opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 520 U. S. 1263.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted to be divided as follows: petitioner, 20 minutes; the Solicitor General, 10 minutes.
